main.description: Announces a Radicle repository owned (or co-maintained) by this account. rkey: the repo id without the 'rad:' prefix. Social surfaces render these; the seed watcher derives its seeding allowlist from them; zaps may reference them via at-uri.

seed.description: Preferred radicle-httpd base URL for browsing/cloning, e.g. https://seed.tessera.at.

builtBy.description: Agent DID that produced this repo, if agent-built. Anchor of the verified-human-backed chain: owner -> delegation -> agent -> repo. Account-asserted until delegation attestations exist.

commissionedBy.description: Optional: the post/zap/task record that commissioned the build.
